title: VIBES fit quality and continuum preservation

text.scope: Bounded local synthetic-addition check on independent real held-out blanks; no cloud job or model refit.
text.acceptance: Descriptive results; no preservation threshold was specified. Optimizer convergence does not establish continuum preservation.
text.new_cloud_run: The separately reported 32,286-fit/G4 job is not connected to this export.
text.definition: Incremental recovery = corrected(blank + known addition) minus corrected(blank). An area recovery of 1 retains the addition, 0 removes it, and negative values reverse its sign. Full-grid spline recovery is unavailable because the spline stops at 1425 cm⁻¹.
text.trace: One declared example: the first held-out blank in the frozen case ledger. Adjacent groups of three channels are averaged for display; metrics use every native channel.
text.reference: The original fit log predates recovery of two failed blank fits. It is not the completion status of the current recovered benchmark or the new 32,286-fit job.
